title: Hearty Umami Tunisian Bamboo Shoot Tagine
description: A flavorful and comforting Tunisian dish featuring bamboo shoots and rest-meat, perfect for a sick day, this shojin-friendly recipe is cooked to perfection in a claypot. The combination of umami flavors and chewy textures will leave you feeling cozy and satisfied.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the claypot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional minute.
Add the rest-meat and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the bamboo shoots, tomato paste, vegetable broth, dried parsley, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Remove the claypot from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
